parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 70 bpm with narrow QRS, normal PR interval and normal R-wave progression. ST segments are isoelectric in the limb leads and lateral leads, with only minimal J-point elevation and tall, upright T waves in V2–V3, which fits a normal variant. There is no ST elevation reaching STEMI criteria, no reciprocal changes and no pathological Q waves, and the voltage is below LVH thresholds.
